name: Laundry Room Tile: The Floor That Has to Survive a Leak
title-tag: Laundry Room Tile Installation | Bothell, WA
meta-description: Tile is the one laundry floor that shrugs off a burst hose - if the assembly under it is right. Membranes, pans, floor drains, and what Bothell homes need.
post-summary: December 1, 2026 · Every laundry room floor should be chosen on the assumption that it will someday be underwater. Tile is the right answer, but tile alone is not waterproof - the membrane, the siliconed perimeter, the raised threshold, and sometimes a floor drain are what turn the room into a pan. Here is the leak-ready build, and why Bothell's upstairs laundries need it most.
